from_node.description: Intentional and synthetic processes present an object across multiple modes of givenness.

to_node.description: The object is held as one and the same intentional object with a stable constituted sense across those givennesses.

bridge.statement: Synthetic identification constitutes the object as one and the same for the relevant intentional horizon; this does not by itself amount to causal production of the object's existence.

audit.cost_note: Constitution layer is profiled, not globalized.

rivals.description: Constitution is read primarily as meaning/objectivity constitution rather than ontic production.
rivals.discriminator: Distinguish sense/objectivity constitution from causal production and metaphysical priority.

kc4.alternative_access: Perceptual misidentification shows that synthesis and numerical identity can diverge.
kc4.revision_trigger: Evidence that the phenomenological dependence is also an ontic production relation.

audit_semantics.relation_rationale: The record encodes constitution of stable intentional sense across modes of givenness; RT09 is retained without promotion to ontic production or metaphysical grounding.
review_notes: RT07 was replaced by RT09; a separate metaphysical-grounding claim would require its own bridge and record.
